Today
My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m really sorry the box didn’t arrive in good shape; I know that’s stressful when you’ve been looking forward to your plants.
To get this in front of our team so they can review and help you with next steps, please reply with:
Your full name
Your email address
Your order number (if you have it handy)
The name of the item that was affected
A few photos: one of the outside of the box, and close-ups of the item itself from a couple of angles
If you’re not able to take photos, just let me know and we’ll work with what you can share.
Once I have that information, I’ll pass everything along to our team so they can review your situation and follow up with you directly. I have routed you to one of my colleagues, who will be happy to assist. Be on the lookout for an email from them soon!
